title: HSK1 Gate 7 · Eastern Han
explanationEn: Gate 7: Eastern Han. Read the words below, then read the story out loud. The story is the same one you read on the map — this is the start of it.
explanation: 第7关：东汉。先读下面的词，再大声读短文。这段短文就是地图上那个故事的开头。
passage: 很久以前，中国还没有纸。人们把字写在竹子上。竹子很重，一本书要用很多竹子，一个人拿不动。东汉的时候，有一个人叫蔡伦。
passageEn: Long ago, China had no paper yet. People wrote characters on bamboo. Bamboo is heavy; one book took a lot of bamboo, and one person could not carry it. In the Eastern Han, there was a man called Cai Lun.

comprehension.questionEn: Read the first sentence again. What does it tell you?
comprehension.question: 再读第一句。它说了什么？
comprehension.answerEn: Long ago, China had no paper yet.
comprehension.answer: 很久以前，中国还没有纸。

comprehension.questionEn: Read the third sentence again. Who or what is it about?
comprehension.question: 再读第三句。它说的是谁，或者是什么？
comprehension.answerEn: Bamboo is heavy; one book took a lot of bamboo, and one person could not carry it.
comprehension.answer: 竹子很重，一本书要用很多竹子，一个人拿不动。

comprehension.questionEn: Read the whole passage out loud, then say one sentence from memory.
comprehension.question: 大声读一遍短文，再试着背出其中的一句。
comprehension.answerEn: Any one sentence from the passage above.
comprehension.answer: 上面短文里的任何一句。

check.promptEn: In the story, what does 中国 mean?
check.prompt: 短文里的“中国”是什么意思？
check.explanationEn: 中国 (Zhōngguó) means "China" — you can find it in the passage above.
check.explanation: “中国”（Zhōngguó）的意思是“China”，就在上面的短文里。

check.promptEn: In the story, what does 字 mean?
check.prompt: 短文里的“字”是什么意思？
check.explanationEn: 字 (zì) means "characters" — you can find it in the passage above.
check.explanation: “字”（zì）的意思是“characters”，就在上面的短文里。

check.zh: 很久以前，中国还没有纸。

options.text: Long ago, a great flood came to China.
The flood went into the fields, and into many people's homes.
People had nowhere to live, and could only go up the mountains to live.
Long ago, China had no paper yet.

check.explanationEn: "很久以前，中国还没有纸。" means "Long ago, China had no paper yet.".
check.explanation: “很久以前，中国还没有纸。”的意思是“Long ago, China had no paper yet.”。

speakingPromptEn: Tell a grown-up about Eastern Han in two or three short Chinese sentences. Use words from the list above.
speakingPrompt: 用上面的词，跟家里的大人说两三句中文，说一说东汉。
